items.title: Warren Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995
items.q: Hank Jones was playing piano, Slam Stewart’s playing bass, Connie Kay’s playing drums, Zoot Sims, Urbie Green, Benny Goodman and me?

ctx.x: I went through a lot of underwear. It was a scary period. Because I really didn’t — I knew I didn’t have the, all the knowledge, and all the confidence necessary to be in that level. You turn around, I was like 21, 22, and Hank Jones was playing piano, Slam Stewart’s playing bass, Connie Kay’s playing drums, Zoot Sims, Urbie Green, Benny Goodman and me?
Had he heard you play at that point? Maybe on a record?
